Consent.title: Participant Consent Statement
Consent.subtitle: Consent to Participate
Consent.intro: Thank you for participating in this study. Before proceeding, please read the following information carefully.
Consent.byParticipating: By participating in this research, you acknowledge and agree that:

points.1: Your responses and usage data within the application may be collected and analyzed for academic research purposes as part of this thesis project.
points.2: The collected data will be used solely for research, evaluation, and improvement of the system and will not be used for commercial purposes.
points.3: Any personal information that could identify you will be anonymized or removed before analysis and publication whenever possible.
points.4: Participation is entirely voluntary. You may choose not to participate or withdraw your consent at any time without penalty.
points.5: Your decision to participate or not participate will not affect your access to the application's core functionality, except for features that require data collection for analysis.
points.6: The research findings may be published in academic reports, presentations, or papers, but no personally identifiable information will be disclosed.

Consent.byAgreeing: By selecting "I Agree", you confirm that:

agreementPoints.1: You have read and understood the information above.
agreementPoints.2: You voluntarily consent to the collection and use of your data for this research.
agreementPoints.3: You are at least the minimum age required to provide consent under applicable laws or have obtained any necessary permission from a parent or legal guardian.
